messages:
Nina (Hiring Manager): New staff SRE starts Mon. Need a concise manager "5-day bootcamp" + 30/60/90 I can paste.
Priya (People Ops): Quick paste below — 1 page, manager-friendly.
Priya (People Ops): ```Manager 5-day bootcamp + 30/60/90
Preboard: device, SSO, Slack, repo teams, PagerDuty; assign buddy.
Day1: 30m manager intro (role, top 3 priorities); buddy tour; EOD 15m check-in + micro-goal.
Day2-3: access complete, run local env, shadow on-call, pair w/ domain SME, open tiny PR.
Day4-5: finish PR, update one runbook, present 10m at Friday sync, 1:1 to set 30d focus.
30/60/90:
30d: 2 small PRs merged; runbook updated; regular in team rituals.
60d: lead small rollout or incident remediation; propose measurable opt.
90d: independent ownership of a service surface with one clear metric to improve.
Manager 1:1 cadence: week1 daily 15m; weeks2-4 twice weekly 30m; after 30d weekly.
Sample team intro: "Please welcome @newhire! Buddy: @Kei. First-week micro-goal: ship a small infra PR."
```
Omar (IT): I'll provision Friday; send job code. Kei (Buddy): I'll schedule pair slots.
onboard-bot: welcome packet queued and calendar template applied.
Nina (Hiring Manager): Thanks, pasting now.
